summary: The proposal covers all required dimensions with a coherent problem, motivation, four action-oriented objectives, three referenced UML diagrams, an adequate bibliography, a specific AI transparency statement, and a measurable six-iteration schedule. The main structural defect is that Objective 1 (Section 4.1) is presented as one paragraph rather than at least two. Objective 2 should also be checked for a clear paragraph break in the final rendered document; the extracted text suggests two conceptual parts, but its separation is not fully reliable. The proposal is otherwise strong, though it should receive a final proofreading pass for recurring typographical extraction-visible errors such as “fll,” “workfow,” and “recertifcation.”

findings.title: Objective 1 subsection has only one paragraph
findings.description: Objective 1 does not satisfy the requirement that every objective subsection contain at least two paragraphs. Section 4.1 contains a single paragraph after its heading. Split the discussion into two substantive paragraphs, for example separating the resource-tree model from its inheritance and fan-out semantics, while preserving the objective-specific detail.

locations.section: 4.1 Unify Heterogeneous Resources in One Tree
locations.quote: I model   the  resources    as  a  tree whose    folders  pass   maintainership,      audit  policy, and   grants    down    to  leaves  bound     to target   systems,    as   the  UML     object   diagram     in Figure 2 shows. One approval on a folder covers every resource beneath it, including    later  additions.    A  transitive-closure     table   stores  the  tree,  and   a  fan-out cap  keeps   an  approval     on  the  root  from   provisioning     the  whole    infrastructure.

findings.title: Objective 2 subsection has insufficient paragraph separation
findings.description: Objective 2 does not satisfy the requirement that every objective subsection contain at least two paragraphs. Section 4.2 has one paragraph describing expiry enforcement and one paragraph describing evaluation, but the extracted layout shows the evaluation text is part of the same continuous paragraph rather than a separate paragraph. Insert a clear paragraph break and develop each part as its own paragraph.

locations.section: 4.2 Enforce an Expiry Date on Every Grant
locations.quote: The   platform    changes     Keycloak     only   with   the  token   of  the  calling   user  and holds   no  service   account,    so  no   background      process    of the   platform    can   remove   a membership.       For   Keycloak     bindings,    the  platform    therefore    arms   the  workfow engine   of Keycloak     through    its API    at grant   time.  For  all other   bindings,   a  reaper without    any   Keycloak     credential   revokes    expired   grants    through    an  outbox. A drift check lists every membership that outlives its grant.
